tasks.command: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | xargs -r grep -nE 'sk-ant-api03-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|glpat-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20}' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'SECRET_PATTERNS' || echo 'CLEAN'

git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | xargs -r grep -nE '(password|secret|token)[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[=:]["'\''\`][^"'\''\`]{8,}' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'example\|placeholder\|REDACTED\|test' || echo 'CLEAN'

tasks.description: Check if .env files are being committed

tasks.command: echo '=== SECRET SCAN REPORT ===' && echo 'API Keys:' && (git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | xargs -r grep -lE 'sk-ant-|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{32}|AKIA|ghp_|glpat-' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && echo '.env files staged:' && (git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^\.env' || echo '0') && echo '=========================='
